label: Forskningsspår: laggad bostadsbeståndsförändring och nettoflyttning
purpose: Test whether observed housing-stock additions contain stable one-year-ahead information about deviations in total net migration beyond the incumbent historical net-migration baseline.

scope.predictor: previous-year change in total dwelling stock

method.housingTotal: sum all mutually exclusive dwelling-stock cells in TAB824
method.responseBaseline: 10-year trailing mean annual net migration using only years known at each origin
method.response: actual net migration minus trailing baseline
method.predictorTransform: previous-year dwelling-stock change minus the mean previous-year dwelling-stock change available in the training sample
method.estimator: ordinary least squares with intercept fixed at zero on centered predictor/response residuals
method.training: expanding history from first usable 2014 pair through origin-1, minimum 4 training pairs
method.forecast: baseline net migration plus beta times centered latest lagged dwelling-stock change

developmentGate: Candidate n+1 MAE must be strictly below comparator for Lulea.
Candidate n+1 MAE must be strictly below comparator for Lulea FA.
Estimated beta must have the same sign in at least five of six development origins for each development geography.
externalGate: Candidate n+1 MAE must be no worse than comparator in every locked FA15 reference region.
Pooled external FA15 n+1 MAE must be strictly below comparator.
The three locked anchor municipalities are robustness checks and must be reported separately.

governance: Research-only explanatory/predictive diagnostic. No housing coefficient may enter the demographic production model from this experiment. No lag, transformation, window, geography or estimator may be changed after results are viewed; any revision is a new candidate.

resultSummary.conclusion: Locked one-year lagged housing-stock change did not generalize across Lulea FA or external FA15 regions. Keep as rejected research evidence; do not retune lag, window or estimator from consumed outcomes.
